cues.en: So
cues.zh: 所以

cues.en: let's say you want to make a video game.
cues.zh: 假设你想做一款电子游戏。

cues.en: Where do you even begin?
cues.zh: 该从哪儿开始呢？

cues.en: Some developers start with a story they want to tell or a premise they want to explore.
cues.zh: 有些开发者从想讲述的故事或想探索的设定出发。

cues.en: Other start with some emotion they want the player to feel like terror or accomplishment.
cues.zh: 有些从想让玩家感受到的情绪出发，比如恐惧或成就感。

cues.en: Others still start by using the technology to simulate something like a planet or a universe.
cues.zh: 还有些开发者从用技术模拟某个东西入手，比如一颗行星或一个宇宙。

cues.en: And of course plenty of developers start by by taking a game that already exists and adding in a few extra features.
cues.zh: 当然，很多开发者是从拿一款现成的游戏、加上一些额外功能开始的。

cues.en: But Nintendo is predictably
cues.zh: 但任天堂不出所料地

cues.en: quite different.
cues.zh: 与众不同。

cues.en: Whether it's making a brand new game or the latest entry in the long running Super Mario series, Nintendo always starts with the same goal,
cues.zh: 无论是做全新游戏，还是推出长篇系列《超级马力欧》的最新作，任天堂总是从同一个目标出发：

cues.en: coming up with a new way to play.
cues.zh: 想出一种新的玩法。

cues.en: So what you do in the game and how you do it is used as the catalyst to drive everything else. From the design of the main character, to the way you deal with enemies, to the genre of music on the soundtrack.
cues.zh: 于是，你在游戏里做什么、怎么做，就成了驱动其他一切的核心。从主角的设计，到应对敌人的方式，再到配乐的音乐类型。

cues.en: That's how we make games at Nintendo, says Shigeru Miyamoto,
cues.zh: “这就是我们在任天堂做游戏的方式，”宫本茂说，

cues.en: creator of Mario, Zelda, Pikmin, and more. We get the fundamentals solid first, then do as much with that core concept as our time and ambition will allow.
cues.zh: 他是马力欧、塞尔达、皮克敏等作品的创造者。“我们先把基础做扎实，然后在时间和雄心的允许范围内，把这个核心概念尽可能发挥到极致。”

cues.en: And so in this episode of Game Maker's Toolkit,
cues.zh: 所以在本期 Game Maker's Toolkit 中，

cues.en: we're going to look at how one of the world's greatest game developers finds success by prioritising play.
cues.zh: 我们来看看世界上最伟大的游戏开发者之一，是如何通过优先考虑“玩”来取得成功的。

cues.en: In
cues.zh: 在

cues.en: many of its games, Nintendo starts by coming up with some interesting new action for the main character to perform.
cues.zh: 它的许多游戏中，任天堂都是先为主角想出某种有趣的新动作。

cues.en: The late Gunpei Yokoi said I first take the character which you're going to control and replace them with a dot as a placeholder.
cues.zh: 已故的 Gunpei Yokoi 说过，我会先把你将要操控的角色拿出来，用一个点代替它作为占位符。

cues.en: Then I think about what kind of movement would be fun.
cues.zh: 然后我会想，什么样的移动方式会好玩。

cues.en: The most famous outcome of this way of thinking
cues.zh: 这种思路最著名的产物

cues.en: is this guy.
cues.zh: 就是这位。

cues.en: You might know him as Mario, but when he arrived on the scene he was simply known as Jumpman
cues.zh: 你可能知道他叫 Mario，但他刚登场时，只叫 Jumpman

cues.en: because this portly Italian plumber is defined by his leap. Not
cues.zh: 因为这个矮胖的意大利水管工，最鲜明的特征就是他的跳跃。不只是

cues.en: only does he have the most dynamic and expressive jump in all of gaming, two d or three d, but his breakout game, Super Mario Brothers, is all about the jump.
cues.zh: 他拥有全游戏界最具动感、最有表现力的跳跃，无论 2D 还是 3D；而且他的成名作《Super Mario Brothers》也全都围绕跳跃展开。

cues.en: Mario leaps onto platforms and over pipes.
cues.zh: Mario 跳上平台，跃过水管。

cues.en: He jumps into bricks to break them and blocks to unleash power ups. And that includes the fire flower, which shoots at an annoying 45 degree angle meaning you have to jump to get a good shot.
cues.zh: 他跳起来顶砖块把它们撞碎，顶方块来释放强化道具。其中还包括火焰花，它很烦人地以 45 度角发射，意味着你得跳起来才能打出好角度。

cues.en: And the flagpole is always one brick off the ground so you have to jump to finish the level.
cues.zh: 而旗杆总是离地一格砖，所以你必须跳起来才能过关。

cues.en: Miyamoto toyed with other ideas including a shoot them up stage but dropped them because we wanted to focus on jumping action.
cues.zh: Miyamoto 试过其他点子，包括一个射击关卡，但放弃了，因为我们想专注于跳跃动作。

cues.en: Oh, and don't forget about jumping on enemies to kill them. That might seem like an obvious way to dispatch foes as that's how Sonic, Aladdin, and scores of other platformer heroes do it. But get this,
cues.zh: 哦，还有别忘了踩敌人来消灭它们。这看起来像是干掉敌人的显然方式，因为 Sonic、Aladdin 和许多其他平台游戏主角都这么做。但听着，

cues.en: no one did it before Mario.
cues.zh: 在 Mario 之前，没人这么做过。

cues.en: Miyamoto came up with that by asking what is the logical way to defeat an enemy in a game about jumping.
cues.zh: Miyamoto 想到这个，是因为他问：在一个关于跳跃的游戏里，击败敌人的合理方式是什么？

cues.en: There's a real advantage to forging a game around a strong main mechanic.
cues.zh: 围绕一个强大的核心机制来打造游戏，确实有很大的优势。

cues.en: When you can interact with almost everything in the game by using this mechanic, Nintendo can make a game where the player's range of actions is very small and easy to learn, but the number of things they can interact with is huge.
cues.zh: 当你几乎可以通过这个机制与游戏中的一切互动时，Nintendo 就能做出这样一款游戏：玩家可执行的操作非常少，也很容易学会，但能互动的对象却多得惊人。

cues.en: When talking about Pikmin, Miyamoto said the basic action that you conduct is very simple. It's a matter of simply throwing the Pikmin at tasks and calling them back. And yet, with the Pikmin's abilities and the breadth of strategies available,
cues.zh: 谈到《Pikmin》时，Miyamoto 说，玩家进行的基本操作非常简单。无非就是把 Pikmin 扔去执行任务，再把它们召回来。然而，凭借 Pikmin 的能力以及丰富的策略选择，

cues.en: it opens up broad possibilities of how you can approach the gameplay.
cues.zh: 玩家可以用各种各样的方式来进行游戏。

cues.en: Other examples of unique actions include shooting a water gun, firing ink, turning into a painting, plucking things out of the ground, and using a vacuum cleaner.
cues.zh: 其他独特操作的例子还包括发射水枪、喷射墨水、变成一幅画、从地里拔出东西，以及使用吸尘器。

cues.en: In Luigi's Mansion for GameCube, Luigi interacts with the world almost exclusively through his vacuum cleaner. He can't even jump but where his brother overcomes every challenge with a big springy leap, Luigi uses his hoover to solve puzzles, suck up ghosts, collect loot, check for booby trap doors, and more.
cues.zh: 在 GameCube 平台的《Luigi's Mansion》中，Luigi 几乎完全依靠吸尘器与世界互动。他甚至不会跳跃；他的兄弟可以用充满弹性的跳跃克服所有挑战，而 Luigi 则用吸尘器解开谜题、吸走幽灵、收集战利品、检查陷阱门等等。

cues.en: So while some developers might say their game is about prejudice or ideology or the decline of the American frontier,
cues.zh: 所以，有些开发者可能会说，他们的游戏讲的是偏见、意识形态，或者美国边疆的衰落，

cues.en: how many games are literally about using a vacuum cleaner?
cues.zh: 但究竟有多少游戏是真正围绕使用吸尘器展开的呢？

cues.en: And when Nintendo needs to add in extra mechanics,
cues.zh: 而当 Nintendo 需要加入额外机制时，

cues.en: it can attach them to those main actions.
cues.zh: 它可以把这些机制附加到那些核心操作上。

cues.en: For example, Splatoon is primarily about shooting ink and swimming in ink.
cues.zh: 比如，Splatoon 主要就是关于射墨水和在墨水里游泳。

cues.en: And so you can reload your gun or climb up a high wall by shooting ink on the floor and then swimming in it. No extra buttons required.
cues.zh: 所以你可以通过朝地面射墨水再游进去，来给枪装弹或爬上高墙。不需要额外按键。

cues.en: God, that's good.
cues.zh: 天哪，这太棒了。

cues.en: Of course, not every game is built around some brand new mechanic.
cues.zh: 当然，并不是每款游戏都围绕某种全新机制打造。

cues.en: Nintendo is, after all, not exactly known for making entirely new games and characters
cues.zh: 毕竟，Nintendo 并不以打造完全全新的游戏和角色而闻名，

cues.en: or new IPs as the industry calls them. And there are only so many things you can strap to the back of a Mario brother. But Nintendo games are still driven by new ways to play and sometimes it's about putting a new twist on an already established mechanic.
cues.zh: 或者说业界所说的新 IP。而且你能往 Mario 兄弟背上绑的东西也就那么多。但 Nintendo 游戏仍然由新的游玩方式驱动，有时只是给已有机制加上新变化。

cues.en: That might involve reinventing two d gameplay in a three d world as we saw in Mario 64 and Zelda Ocarina of Time.
cues.zh: 这可能包括在 3D 世界里重塑 2D 玩法，就像我们在 Mario 64 和 Zelda: Ocarina of Time 中看到的那样。

cues.en: It might be about putting those old mechanics
cues.zh: 也可能是把那些旧机制

cues.en: interesting new context.
cues.zh: 放进有趣的新情境。

cues.en: Like Super Mario Galaxy which is still fundamentally
cues.zh: 比如 Super Mario Galaxy，它本质上仍然

cues.en: about jumping but now in microgravity.
cues.zh: 是关于跳跃，但这次是在微重力下。

cues.en: Or how Pikmin three is still about commanding Pikmin but now with the added stress of juggling three heroes.
cues.zh: 或者像 Pikmin 3，仍然是指挥 Pikmin，但现在还要同时兼顾三个主角，压力更大了。

cues.en: And sometimes Nintendo looks to come up with an interesting new system that governs how you play,
cues.zh: 有时 Nintendo 会尝试设计一套有趣的新系统来支配你的游玩方式，

cues.en: like the three day timer in Majora's Mask or the interconnected map of Metroid.
cues.zh: 比如 Majora's Mask 的三天计时器，或 Metroid 的互联地图。

cues.en: Whatever the case, there's got to be some new gameplay that can drive things or Nintendo says there's no point making the game. When Miyamoto was told that fans wanted to see a new f zero game, he said I'd like to ask those people why f zero? What do you want that we haven't done before? To Miyamoto,
cues.zh: 无论如何，总得有一些新玩法来推动一切，否则 Nintendo 会说做这款游戏没有意义。当 Miyamoto 被告知粉丝想看新的 F-Zero 游戏时，他说：我想问问那些人，为什么是 F-Zero？你们想要什么我们以前没做过的东西？对 Miyamoto 来说，

cues.en: the thought of just making another racing game with more attractive graphics is unfathomable.
cues.zh: 仅仅再做一款画面更漂亮的赛车游戏，这种想法简直不可想象。

cues.en: Nintendo
cues.zh: 任天堂

cues.en: designers are big fans of the design principle
cues.zh: 设计师们非常推崇一条设计原则

cues.en: form follows function.
cues.zh: 形式追随功能。

cues.en: Which basically means that how something looks is determined by how that thing works.
cues.zh: 意思就是，一个东西长什么样，取决于它怎么运作。

cues.en: It's something that Miyamoto likely picked up when studying industrial design at college.
cues.zh: 宫本茂大概是在大学学工业设计时学到的。

cues.en: And it's why boos blush when you look at them, and why enemies that charge at you in Super Mario World look like quarterbacks.
cues.zh: 这也是为什么你盯着害羞鬼看时它会脸红，为什么《超级马力欧世界》里冲你撞过来的敌人长得像橄榄球四分卫。

cues.en: And it's why whenever Nintendo re releases the original Mario Brothers, it swaps turtles for spinies because everyone keeps trying to jump on the damn turtles.
cues.zh: 也是为什么任天堂每次重发初代《马力欧兄弟》，都要把乌龟换成刺刺龟——因为大家总想去踩那些该死的乌龟。

cues.en: But Nintendo goes further than that and uses the new gameplay at the heart of a game to determine almost every aspect of the presentation.
cues.zh: 但任天堂走得更远：它用游戏核心的新玩法来决定几乎所有的表现形式。

cues.en: Once Splatoon's mechanics had been developed, producer Hisashi Nagami says we then conceived the characters and the world vision to match perfectly with the gameplay.
cues.zh: 制作人野上恒说，《斯普拉遁》的机制做出来之后，我们才构思角色和世界观，让它们与玩法完美契合。

cues.en: So if you ever got to play Splatoon during the prototyping phases,
cues.zh: 所以如果你在原型阶段玩过《斯普拉遁》，

cues.en: you would have controlled a big white block. The designers came up with the Squid Kids afterwards
cues.zh: 你操控的会是一大块白色方块。设计师生出鱿鱼小子是后来的事，

cues.en: when they needed to find a character that could swim in ink and would clearly separate the inking and swimming mechanics.
cues.zh: 那时他们需要找一个能在墨水里游的角色，并且能把涂地和游水两种机制清楚区分开。

cues.en: And entire characters can come about as extensions of mechanics themselves.
cues.zh: 甚至整个角色都可以是机制本身的延伸。

cues.en: Like Navi, who is a personification
cues.zh: 比如娜薇，她就是《时之笛》里

cues.en: of the Zed targeting system in Ocarina of Time. Or this Lokitu, who carries the newfangled camera in Super Mario 64.
cues.zh: Z 锁定系统的化身。再比如《超级马力欧64》里那个扛着新奇摄像机的拉基图。

cues.en: Or the Luma, who hides in Mario's hat and shows the player when Mario's spin move is recharged.
cues.zh: 或者是 Luma，它藏在马里奥的帽子里，告诉玩家马里奥的旋转招式什么时候充能完毕。

cues.en: In this way, gameplay needn't be abstract systems but organic parts of the game world.
cues.zh: 这样一来，游戏机制不必是抽象的系统，而可以成为游戏世界中有机的组成部分。

cues.en: Splatoon's producer also revealed that because shooting ink is a bit like spraying graffiti, the game got its punk rock music and nineties aesthetic.
cues.zh: 《斯普拉遁》的制作人还透露，因为喷射墨汁有点像涂鸦喷漆，这款游戏才有了朋克摇滚音乐和九十年代的美学风格。

cues.en: Similarly,
cues.zh: 类似地，

cues.en: the only reason Super Mario Sunshine is set on a tropical island is because the water pistol gameplay made the designers think about summer.
cues.zh: 《超级马里奥阳光》设定在热带岛屿上的唯一原因，就是水枪玩法让设计师联想到了夏天。

cues.en: The mechanic can even drive the narrative.
cues.zh: 游戏机制甚至可以驱动叙事。

cues.en: Sorry to burst your bubble, but the story in the Zelda games isn't part of some grand overarching narrative but it's simply there to bring out the best of the fun and interesting gameplay elements according to the late Nintendo president Satoru Iwata.
cues.zh: 很抱歉扫你的兴，但按照已故任天堂社长岩田聪的说法，塞尔达系列游戏的剧情并不是某个宏大总体叙事的一部分，而只是为了把那些有趣好玩的游戏元素发挥到极致。

cues.en: A Link Between Worlds has a mad artist for an antagonist because Nintendo needed some reason for why Link can turn into a painting.
cues.zh: 《众神的三角力量2》的反派是个疯狂画家，就是因为任天堂需要一个理由，解释林克为什么能变成画作。

cues.en: And even Ocarina of Time's beloved story came from a process like this. Miyamoto wanted both young and teenage Link in the same game so the writers had to come up with a time travel plot to make it happen.
cues.zh: 就连《时之笛》备受喜爱的剧情也来自类似的过程。宫本茂想让幼年林克和少年林克同时出现在一款游戏里，于是编剧不得不想出一个时间旅行的剧情来实现这一点。

cues.en: This might seem like a crazy way to come up with a story but it can help ensure that there's a deep connection between what you do in the game and what happens in the story. Consider Yoshi's Island which has a narrative about protecting baby Mario and gameplay mechanics about protecting baby Mario.
cues.zh: 用这种方式构思故事看起来可能很疯狂，但它能确保你在游戏中的所作所为与剧情的发展之间有着深度的联系。想想《耀西岛》，它的剧情讲的是保护婴儿马里奥，而游戏机制也正是保护婴儿马里奥。

cues.en: Most developers come at it the other way round.
cues.zh: 大多数开发者恰恰相反。

cues.en: They dream up stories,
cues.zh: 他们先构想故事、

cues.en: characters, and worlds and then work backwards to figure out what gameplay mechanics might fit. It's no surprise that they're rarely very successful.
cues.zh: 角色和世界，再倒推设计合适的玩法机制。难怪他们很少能成功。

cues.en: But okay. I shouldn't paint Nintendo as some game design gods and every other developer is just getting it completely wrong.
cues.zh: 但好吧，我不该把任天堂塑造成游戏设计之神，而其他开发者全都做错了。

cues.en: Though maybe...
cues.zh: 不过也许……

cues.en: No. No. No. No. No. Nintendo gets it wrong sometimes and other developers get it oh so right.
cues.zh: 不不不不不。任天堂有时也会出错，其他开发者也能做得非常出色。

cues.en: Indie developers, for example, are particularly good at building their games around unique gameplay.
cues.zh: 比如独立开发者，特别擅长围绕独特玩法来构建游戏。

cues.en: And I loved how the new Doom completely orbits around the melee mechanic. It's at the heart of the combat system, it gives you health, and it ties into movement.
cues.zh: 我很喜欢新《Doom》完全围绕近战机制来设计。它是战斗系统的核心，能给你回血，还与移动紧密结合。

cues.en: You even use the melee button to open doors just like how Samus opens doors by shooting them. Doom might be the most Nintendo game that Nintendo would never ever make.
cues.zh: 你甚至用近战键开门，就像萨姆斯用射击开门一样。《Doom》可能是任天堂永远不会做、却最有任天堂味道的游戏。

cues.en: And then you get a game like Portal which is so beautifully built around one super smart
cues.zh: 再比如《Portal》，它围绕一个极其聪明的

cues.en: interactivity that it's no surprise Miyamoto has said that game was amazing.
cues.zh: 交互机制精妙构建，难怪宫本茂说那款游戏非常棒。

cues.en: Because for Nintendo, the way you play a game is simply more important than anything else. So it's not just the jumping off point for a new project but every other element. The enemies, graphical style, locations, music, stories, and characters are picked and produced to frame the most fundamental aspect of a game.
cues.zh: 因为对任天堂来说，你玩游戏的方式就是比其他一切都重要。所以它不仅是一个新项目的起点，也是其他所有元素的出发点。敌人、美术风格、场景、音乐、故事和角色，都是为了让游戏最根本的方面得以呈现而挑选和制作的。

cues.en: And when every aspect of the game is suggesting the way you play it, It becomes effortless to pick the game up and get stuck in. And so this is one big reason why Nintendo's
cues.zh: 当游戏的每个方面都在暗示你该怎么玩时，拿起游戏并沉浸进去就变得毫不费力。所以这就是为什么任天堂的

cues.en: games often feel quite different to everything else on the market.
cues.zh: 游戏常常让人觉得和市场上其他一切都很不一样。

cues.en: They're more playful and toy like than most other games. They're more accessible and inviting but no less complex.
cues.zh: 它们比大多数其他游戏更俏皮、更像玩具。它们更易上手、更吸引人，但复杂度丝毫不减。

cues.en: And quite frankly, they're some of the most elegantly designed games ever made.
cues.zh: 而且坦白说，它们是有史以来设计得最优雅的一些游戏。

cues.en: And so, even after missteps and miscalculations,
cues.zh: 所以，即便经历过失误和误判，

cues.en: we're there. Ready and waiting for whatever this iconic Japanese developer comes up with next. Next.
cues.zh: 我们仍在这里。准备好迎接这家标志性的日本开发商接下来带来的任何东西。下一集。

cues.en: Hey there. Thanks so much for watching. This episode was a pretty big undertaking but I hope it sheds some new light on what makes Nintendo such a fascinating game developer.
cues.zh: 大家好。非常感谢观看。这一集工作量相当大，但我希望它能让人重新认识是什么让任天堂成为如此迷人的游戏开发商。

cues.en: I wanted to say a huge thank you for helping me reach 100,000
